subject: PilotAI — monthly burn validation & procurement lane
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maddy Chen <maddy@pilotai.com>, PilotAI Procurement <procurement@pilotai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: PilotAI — monthly burn validation & procurement lane

Hi Maddy / PilotAI procurement team —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and a few concrete asks so we can finalize a pilot quote and procurement path:

Call highlights (short):
- Pilot scope: conversational support + document summarization for onboarding flows (endpoints + embeddings).
- Expected ramp window: 6–8 weeks to pilot steady-state.
- Primary success metric: 90% reduction in human triage time on onboarding flows.

Cost & procurement items we need to confirm from your side:
1) Monthly token range you expect during the pilot and steady-state (give a best-case / base / high-case).
2) Target unit economics: any internal $/1M-token target we should hit for procurement signoff?
3) Procurement threshold that triggers a PO vs credit card (monthly spend threshold and any required lead time for legal/PO).

What we'll deliver after you confirm the items above:
- A tailored pricing estimate (attached stub: pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx).
- A short SOW draft we can hand to legal (attached: SOW_draft_PilotAI.pdf).
- A recommended procurement path (PO template + timeline).

Ask: can you reply with 1–3 above by EOD Wednesday (Dec 2)? If easier, feel free to answer inline. If you prefer another cadence for procurement review, flag it and we'll accommodate.

Attachments: pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 58KB), SOW_draft_PilotAI.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Maddy Chen <maddy@pilotai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: PilotAI Procurement <procurement@pilotai.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@pilotai.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PilotAI — monthly burn validation & procurement lane

Thanks, Soojin — good recap. Answers inline below.

1) Monthly token ranges (pilot / steady / upside):
- Pilot (weeks 1–8): 120–180M tokens/month (chat + embeddings peaks).
- Steady-state (post-pilot): 300–350M tokens/month.
- Upside (scale): 500M+ tokens/month if we move more flows to the model.

2) Target unit economics: internal target is $10–$15 per 1M tokens for vendor selection — lower is better. For pilot approval, finance is OK with up to $18/1M if we put a clear success milestone and short commitment.

3) Procurement thresholds:
- Any monthly spend above $5,000 requires a formal PO (we can do net-30).
- < $5,000/month can go through our centralized corporate card program (but requires spend owner approval).
- Legal lead time for our standard SOW is ~10 business days; procurement lead time for PO issuance is typically 5–7 business days once SOW is signed.

We attached our internal approval matrix to show how pilot budgets are funneled (PilotAI_budget_matrix.xlsx). Also: finance asked whether Redwood supports a short-term committed discount for the pilot (e.g., 3-month min commit) — we'll need some numbers to take to them.

Let us know two pricing scenarios you can offer quickly: (A) pay-as-you-go (no commit), (B) a 3-month pilot commit option with a minimum token commitment and discounted $/1M.

Thanks —
Maddy Chen
Head of Product, PilotAI
maddy@pilotai.com | +1 (617) 555-4422

[Attachment: PilotAI_budget_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maddy Chen <maddy@pilotai.com>, PilotAI Procurement <procurement@pilotai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PilotAI — monthly burn validation & procurement lane

Maddy — really helpful, thanks for the clarity. Below are two concrete scenarios we can pull into a short quote and SOW. I'll attach a pricing worksheet and flag the fields you can drop into finance.

Scenario A — Pay-as-you-go (no commitment)
- Unit price: $18 per 1M tokens
- No minimums, billed monthly
- Good for fast pilots; higher per-unit cost but no term lock-in

Scenario B — Pilot commitment (3 months)
- Suggested commitment band: 300M tokens over 3 months (100M/month average)
- Discounted unit price: $12 per 1M tokens while committed
- Early-exit: prorated reconciliation if you stop after month 1 or 2 (no back-charges beyond pro-rata)

Optional enterprise reserved band (12 months) — noted for long-term planning
- Example: 3.6B tokens/year → $10 per 1M tokens (annual reserved pricing, paid monthly or upfront)

How this maps to your thresholds:
- With the pilot commit at 300M/3mo the expected monthly spend is ~ $1,200 (at $12/1M) — below your $5k PO threshold, which means the pilot could run on your corporate card or a small PO depending on finance preference.
- If you ramp to 300–350M/mo steady-state at $12/1M, monthly spend would be $3,600–$4,200 — still below $5k.
- Upside to 500M+/mo would trigger larger PO needs; we can provide a short-term bridge credit or billing cadence options to help with procurement.

Next steps:
1) I will upload a short quote (pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx) and SOW template (SOW_draft_PilotAI.pdf) to the Drive link and send a DocuSign-ready copy if that helps speed legal.
2) If PilotAI wants the committed pilot, confirm the 300M/3mo band and I will mark pricing and lock the rate for 14 days.
3) Schedule a procurement sync (15–20m) with your procurement manager to confirm PO timing — we have availability Wed/Thu next week.

Attachments: pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 58KB), SOW_draft_PilotAI.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

cc Marissa & Jordan so they can prep the one-page procurement playbook.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Soojin / Jordan — quick internal note after reviewing the numbers.

We should approve a lowered PO threshold for this pilot to remove friction: authorize pilot runs up to $2,500/month on a PO with streamlined legal review. Rationale: PilotAI is a product-led startup with clear scale signals (product + embeddings usage) and they indicated finance will accept short lead times if we provide a locked pilot rate.

Action for Soojin: when you send the quote, include a one-line PO template that states the $2,500/month exception and our acceptance criteria (success milestone at end of month 2). I'll backstop this on the deal and approve the reduced threshold in HubSpot.

Also loop Jordan for any technical Qs on estimated token churn assumptions.
